headline: Sadbhav Engineering holds Annual General Meeting on September 30
hook: Routine procedural filing from Sadbhav Engineering
summary: Sadbhav Engineering Limited has informed stock exchanges about the proceedings of its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. Such filings document routine shareholder approvals and resolutions for the listed entity. Retail investors track these disclosures for official updates on company governance and annual business adoptions. The filing itself carries no immediate financial impact on share prices.
why_it_matters: No direct financial impact for retail shareholders.
